page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top and page number at top right. No marginal notes, no catchword, no signature.
page.running_head: MADE BY A JESUIT IN IRELAND.

main_text.p: nians, together with the Syrians and Chaldeans that are subject to the patriarchs of Antioch and Babylon, from Cyprus and Palæstina unto the East-Indies. And this may suffice for the discovery of this new found creek of purgatory.

page.notes: Running head is set in small capitals and is transcribed in capitals. The page opens mid-sentence ("nians" is the end of a word broken from the previous page, kept as a fragment). Faint show-through and specks on the page are not transcribed.
